items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private. Source rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete; all four legal checklist tasks are open. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. Do not send external outreach or change the private gate without human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Keep the gated product private. Source rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete; all four legal checklist tasks are open. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. Do not send external outreach or change the private gate without human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send external outreach, and do not propose go-live. Evidence: API access mechanics are documented, but rights to fetch, store, transform, cache, display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize are not established; current public terms point against the proposed use. Non-legal accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, security/release, and owner gates remain blocked. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown, including open banner/consent findings on 16 sites and privacy/terms findings on 4; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission, $0 site-attributed commission; do not assign aggregate revenue or claim ROI. Implementation decision: launch_gate remains private_only and legal_review status is needs_owner, reviewed_by legal; no go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence is recorded for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked and counsel_required; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Smallest next actions: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking; produce the read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. Keep the private gate unchanged and do not send outreach.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked and counsel_required for any public display, derivative storage, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising; missing current permission, field-level rights, provenance, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and monetization terms. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, property and data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures. No legal item is clear or conditional enough to support public launch. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved.
